independent_qa.detail: Independent GPT QA reproduced semantic and storage defects, reran the fixes, and matched all 15 real local Qwen reference-case outputs against the integrated CLI run.

independent_review.detail: Opus completed the initial implementation audit and reproduced partial retry and semantic limitations. The final runtime review is pending.

arm64_dependency_install.detail: Pinned torch wheel restored from 244 bounded ranges and verified by full SHA-256. Frozen offline sync, dependency check and native imports passed.

complete_pinned_assets.detail: The entire qwen3:8b artifact and publisher manifest verified on the Mac. Only Hojo merged_full_model.safetensors is still being acquired.

frontend_truncation.detail: Ten native cases each for NumPy and PyTorch confirmed the 30-second stored setting and 40-second wheel override. The application enforces 25 seconds with padding.

codec_decoding.detail: Five tests using native FFmpeg 7.1 covered WAV, FLAC, MP3 and M4A, stereo right-channel retention, resampling, corrupt WAV and spool limits.

silero_segmentation.detail: Actual packaged Silero produced one segment on the six-second FLEURS recording. Seven native audio tests passed, covering silence and active speech at EOF. The installed CLI returned no_speech on 32,037 silent frames with no observations.

local_schema_extraction.detail: Pinned local Ollama generated schema-constrained replies on all five required French probe cases. Final production observations cover both correction paths, unknown carton contents and the explicit 24-bottle total. Independent validation remains necessary for uniqueItems and semantic constraints.

validated_exports_and_replay.detail: Fixture observations exercise transactional history and correction replay. Two actual installed-CLI silence imports produced a single stored generation and byte-identical CSV. Speech-bearing model outputs are tracked separately. Concurrent saves and explicit exports targeting one directory also passed process and race regressions, including interrupted-writer recovery.

reference_semantics.detail: Scripted replies exercise the real validator. It checks a selected quote against the surrounding source clause for omitted negation, clipped quantities and borrowing a quantity from a different product. Real-model quality is tracked by the reference evaluation.

long_boundary_and_no_loss.detail: Real FFmpeg/Silero on 65.768 seconds produced four chunks, including two 400,000-sample inputs, and flushed to EOF. The ASR boundary-phrase and observation assertions still require the weights.

offline_control_app_and_daemon.detail: The dedicated Ollama, installed CLI and its identified ASR child each received EPERM for external IPv4 and IPv6 connections and HTTP 200 over loopback. IPv6 outside the sandbox had no route. The native attempt ran Silero, then stopped at the missing checkpoint.

offline_file_inference.detail: The later native attempt reached Silero and recorded the blocked Hojo load with exit 12. Offline inference requires the full speech and extraction models.

microphone_and_backpressure.detail: Reviewer exercised the mic entry point before the required file gate. Capture implementation pending.

french_wer.detail: NOT MEASURED. Two FLEURS recordings total 20.46 s.

field_scores.detail: Reference transcripts: field precision and recall were 1.0 for all 15 scored fields with positive denominators, including 15 quantities, 15 units, one negation and two correction links. Abstention was 3/19. The curated set was used in development. ASR-derived field scoring is a separate gate.

production_reference_acceptance.detail: The installed offline CLI evaluated all 15 French transcript fixtures twice with real qwen3:8b, once under independent QA. Each run represented all 16 gold observations and marked three additional candidates for review. Independent QA matched all 15 full observation sets and confirmed the runner unloaded.
